RULES:

HANDOFF — the next wave reads your packets instead of reconstructing your work from git. Report an outcome for EVERY task you were given:
  { "tasks": [ { "id": "<task id>", "outcome": "ok" | "failed" | "not-attempted",
      "handoff": { "schema": "interlock.wave-handoff/1", "taskId": "<same id>", "status": "ok" | "blocked" | "partial",
        "summary": "...", "evidence": ["path:12-40"], "next": "...", "blocker": null } } ] }
- One packet per task you ATTEMPTED, keyed by its own id. One packet cannot stand in for several tasks.
- A "not-attempted" task carries no packet. That absence is expected, not an error.
- A result that omits a task you were given fails every task in this lane, so report all 3.
- Do not pass a packet between your own tasks — you already know what you just did.
- status "ok" means blocker is null; "blocked" and "partial" need a non-empty blocker.
- evidence is at most 8 locators (path, path:line, path:start-end) — never file bodies.
- Keep it terse. A packet over the character cap `interlock limits` publishes fails the task, and it is never truncated for you.
